resources.string: Forenza needs the camera to photograph a field test card so it can measure the colour change on this device. The analysis runs on this phone only, and any result is presumptive — it still needs laboratory confirmation.

Forenza records where the sample was seized so the location can be shown on the digital inventory given to the Magistrate. If the location cannot be determined, the test is still saved and the record is flagged as having no coordinates.
The reference colour anchors used in this mode were created for this project. They are not official NCB data and not a measurement of any physical kit.
This mode demonstrates the complete Forenza field-testing workflow using a synthetic reference card.
1. Enter the officer badge and confirm the device credential.
2. Place a demonstration reference card inside the camera frame.
4. Forenza measures the captured test colour and compares it with the synthetic reference profile.
Whichever reference card you use decides the outcome, because the outcome is measured from the card. Either demonstration card can be photographed.
Runs the normal test workflow against a synthetic reference card. Demonstration only — not a real drug test and not forensically validated.
